conditions: User must be a CCPA subject to pass the Do Not Sell status
effects: Passes the CCPA Do Not Sell status to the Taboola SDK for data handling
Enables or disables the sale of personal data based on user consent

conditions: The CCPA applies to the user
effects: When cdns is false, Taboola can use the user's data as the user consented
When cdns is true, Taboola must not use the user's data as the user did not consent
When cdns is none, CCPA does not apply and data usage is allowed

conditions: User must be a GDPR subject to pass the consent status
effects: Passes the user's consent status to the Taboola SDK for data handling
Enables or disables the use of personal data based on user consent

conditions: The user is subject to GDPR
effects: When cex is true, Taboola can use the user's data as the user provided consent
When cex is false, Taboola must not use the user's data as the user did not provide consent
